record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:376 — When several destinations have no credentialId, each one re-runs createEvent on every organizer credential of that integration type, which creates duplicate external events and wastes API calls

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, when `event.destinationCalendar` is an array, the code loops each `destination`. For destinations *without* `credentialId`, it executes `destinationCalendarCredentials = this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and then runs `createEvent(c, event)` for *every* matching credential (no filtering by that destination’s `externalId`). Because this happens inside the per-destination loop, multiple destinations of the same `integration` will cause the same organizer credentials to create the event repeatedly (duplicates + wasted API calls). This matches the finding.
